scripts.dev: pnpm run --filter @oligopoly/worker dev & pnpm run --filter @oligopoly/web dev & wait
scripts.ci:build: pnpm run --filter @oligopoly/validation build && pnpm run --filter @oligopoly/shared build
scripts.ci:verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:unit --coverage && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.ci:local: pnpm run ci:build && pnpm run ci:verify
scripts.db:migrate:dev: pnpm --filter @oligopoly/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply oligopoly-db --local
